description: This file defines the SaltedSeedSeq class, a template class that wraps an existing seed sequence to add extra entropy (salting) for random number generation. It includes methods for generating seed data, parameter extraction, and internal utility structures. It also provides functions to create salted seed sequences.

classes.name: SaltedSeedSeq
classes.description: A template class that wraps a seed sequence to add salting (extra entropy) for enhanced randomness.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Fills a range with seed data, mixing in salt if applicable.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Extracts parameters from the seed sequence.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the seed sequence.
